instructions: 1. PR #342 is the highest open layer of stack #35 in `owner/repo` whose open lower layers are all ready. Run `GH_REPO=owner/repo gh stack merge 342 --yes --squash` to merge PR #342 and every unmerged layer below it. When the base uses a merge queue, the same command queues that prefix together and GitHub evaluates each layer from the bottom; a failure ejects that layer and the layers above it. If `gh stack` is an unknown command, run `gh extension install github/gh-stack` first.
2. After the merge attempt, rerun this same `--stack --merge` selector; GitHub retargets the next layer onto `main`. Shepherd any layer that GitHub rejects or ejects.
